June 2, 2018 - By Vivian Currie
Patten & Patten Inc increased its stake in Cisco Systems Inc. (CSCO) by 2.61% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Patten & Patten Inc bought 7,607 shares as the company’s stock declined 4.63% with the market. The institutional investor held 299,512 shares of the technology company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $12.85 million, up from 291,905 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Patten & Patten Inc who had been investing in Cisco Systems Inc. for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $210.33B market cap company. The stock increased 2.22% or $0.95 during the last trading session, reaching $43.66. About 16.40 million shares traded. Cisco Systems, Inc. (NASDAQ:CSCO) has risen 37.60% since June 2, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 25.03% the S&P500.
Scott & Selber Inc decreased its stake in Facebook Inc (FB) by 33.62% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Scott & Selber Inc who had been investing in Facebook Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $561.53 billion market cap company.
